mapper.select: SELECT reservation_id, user_id, counselor_id, consultation_type, category, reservation_date, reservation_time, request_message, consult_info_json, diagnosis_json, status, created_at, ended_at FROM consultation_reservation WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY reservation_date DESC, reservation_time DESC

SELECT reservation_id, user_id, counselor_id, consultation_type, category, reservation_date, reservation_time, request_message, consult_info_json, diagnosis_json, status, created_at, ended_at FROM consultation_reservation WHERE counselor_id = #{counselorId} ORDER BY reservation_date ASC, reservation_time ASC

SELECT reservation_id, user_id, counselor_id, consultation_type, category, reservation_date, reservation_time, request_message, consult_info_json, diagnosis_json, status, created_at, ended_at FROM consultation_reservation WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE consultation_reservation SET status = 'IN_PROGRESS' WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND status = 'RESERVED'
UPDATE consultation_reservation SET status = 'COMPLETED', ended_at = NOW() WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND status IN ('RESERVED', 'IN_PROGRESS')
